stem: Who among of the following was not a member of Interim Cabinet?
expl: The Interim Government of India was formed on 2 September, 1946 AD from the newly elected Constituent Assembly as per the Cabinet Mission Plan which was declared on 24 August, 1946 AD. After inclusion of League in the Interim Government, Jawaharlal Nehru, Vallabhbhai Patel, Rajendra Prasad, Ibrahim Ismail Chundrigar, C. Rajagopalachari, Baldev Singh, Liaqat Ali Khan, Ghazanfar Ali Khan, Jagjivan Ram, Abdur Rab Nishtar, Asaf Ali and C.H. Bhabha were included. Some members like Sarat Chandra Bose, Sir Shafat Ahmed Khan and Syed Ali Zaheer appointed earlier resigned to make room for the Muslim League nominees Who joined constituent Assembly on 26 October, 1946 AD. B.R. Ambedkar was not included in Interim Cabinet.

stem: In which province Muslim League formed their Government after 1946 elections?
expl: Muslim League formed Government in Bengal under A.K. Fazlul Haq with an alliance of Krishak Praja Party in the elections of 1946 AD but later the ministerial cabinet of the Muslim League was formed. The leader of the Muslim League in Bengal and Prime Minister of the province was H.S. Suhrawardy.

stem: Muslim League observed the ‘Direct Action Day’ on :
expl: 16th August, 1946 was the date which was decided by Muslim League as the ‘Direct Action Day.’ Muslim League demanded separate Pakistan by rejecting the interim cabinet decision of Viceroy. On that day, by spreading riots, they wanted to show that Hindus and Muslims can not exist together. During the action, ‘Noakhali’ was the center of riots.
